records.title: Search index rebuild after schema change
records.body:
Rebuild the whole search index when the document schema changes. A partial
search index rebuild leaves old-schema documents unreachable by the new
analyzer, and the symptom is a silent drop in search recall, so nothing alerts
on a half-rebuilt search index.

records.title: Search index alias swap
records.body:
Rebuild the whole search index under a fresh index name when the document
schema changes, and swap the search alias once the search index rebuild
finishes. Rebuilding the search index in place leaves the search index
unqueryable for the whole rebuild, and search recall drops silently.
